analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($58.08) vs SMA5/20/50 ($56.72/$66.37/$71.89): Above SMA5, below SMA20/50, attempting short-term rebound but mid-to-long term trend is weak.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($71.96)/SMA200 ($65.47): Below mid-to-long term moving averages, indicating a weak long-term trend.
· 52-week position (40.9%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (31.5 → 39.3): Attempting to exit oversold, weak upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.2812 → -1.4390): Weakness persists, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower $51.84, Middle $66.37): Approaching lower band, band width is wide at 43.79%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($57.59): Higher level compared to Pivot S1 ($45.89).
· Swing resistance ($60.69): Potential for strengthened short-term rebound upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern: Higher Low unconfirmed, potential for Lower High.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.67x): Subdued compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: Short-term rebound attempt within a downtrend, weakness persists due to lack of volume. Conditions for entering a position: RSI recovery above 45 and MACD histogram improvement confirmed.
